0022600114.text: Both the Orlando Magic and the New York Knicks are 0-2 and have lost their last two games, with the Magic 4th in the Southeast and 14th in the East and the Knicks 5th in the Atlantic and 12th in the East. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain) are out for Orlando, while Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Paolo Banchero (ankle soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025 in Orlando, a 132-120 Knicks win.
